name: Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, the empty-coordinate projection has one trace and one shattered set, so it is admissible with VC dimension zero. For $n\ge2$, project onto any $n-1$ coordinates. The traces are the empty set and their $n-1$ singletons, giving $n$ shattered sets and VC dimension one. A VC-zero nonempty projection has one trace and only the empty set shattered, so it cannot meet the required count $n\ge2$. Thus the minimum is one.
